evidence.claim: Putin's recognition decrees for the self-proclaimed DPR and LPR said Ukraine had refused peaceful settlement under the Minsk agreements and ordered the Russian military to perform peacekeeping functions there.
evidence.title: Путин поручил Минобороны РФ обеспечить поддержание мира в ДНР и ЛНР
evidence.excerpt: Putin's recognition decrees for the self-proclaimed DPR and LPR said Ukraine had refused peaceful settlement under the Minsk agreements and ordered the Russian military to perform peacekeeping functions there.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Russian-language publication of the decree text on the day it was signed.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct presidential decree attributable to Putin.
contrary_evidence: The decrees were widely treated internationally as a prelude to aggression rather than peacekeeping.

evidence.claim: Memorial said 2022 was marked by de facto military censorship, 74 new names were added to the main political-prisoner list, and more than 5,000 administrative cases and 200-plus criminal cases targeted anti-army speech.
evidence.title: Политзаключённые и политические репрессии в России в 2022 году
evidence.excerpt: Memorial said 2022 was marked by de facto military censorship, 74 new names were added to the main political-prisoner list, and more than 5,000 administrative cases and 200-plus criminal cases targeted anti-army speech.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Local-language retrospective report with explicit annual statistics and repression categories.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to Putin’s regime because the report describes state repression in response to anti-war speech and public dissent.
contrary_evidence: The report is a retrospective summary and not a contemporaneous government record.

evidence.claim: Putin told Russian business leaders that he had no choice but to order the operation against Ukraine and framed the war as a forced decision.
evidence.title: Putin tells Russian business people he had no choice over Ukraine
evidence.excerpt: Putin told Russian business leaders that he had no choice but to order the operation against Ukraine and framed the war as a forced decision.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters is a high-quality wire service; the claim reports Putin's own remarks contemporaneously.
evidence.ruler_attribution: direct speech by Putin, fully attributable to him
contrary_evidence: Later reporting showed the invasion was a deliberate strategic choice, not an unavoidable necessity.

evidence.claim: Russia said it would reduce military activity on the Kyiv and Chernihiv fronts after the Istanbul talks and had received Ukrainian written proposals on neutrality.
evidence.title: Kommersant reports Russia will reduce military activity on Kyiv and Chernihiv fronts after Istanbul talks
evidence.excerpt: Russia said it would reduce military activity on the Kyiv and Chernihiv fronts after the Istanbul talks and had received Ukrainian written proposals on neutrality.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Domestic reporting is useful for the statement and chronology, though it is less independent than international wire reporting.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Putin's government controlled the negotiation posture and military response, but the move was also shaped by battlefield conditions.
contrary_evidence: Whether this was a genuine de-escalation or a tactical redeployment remained disputed.

evidence.claim: The central bank raised the key rate because inflation was above forecast and demand was outpacing output capacity.
evidence.title: Bank of Russia raises key rate because inflation was above forecast
evidence.excerpt: The central bank raised the key rate because inflation was above forecast and demand was outpacing output capacity.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary official monetary-policy statement with explicit rationale and date.
evidence.ruler_attribution: indirect: the Bank of Russia acted under its own mandate, though the broader policy environment was shaped by Putin's state
contrary_evidence: This reflects central-bank autonomy, so it cannot be credited fully to Putin alone.

evidence.claim: The central bank said the late-February rate hike and capital controls helped support the stable functioning of the financial system.
evidence.title: Central bank says 28 February hike and capital controls helped support stable functioning of financial system
evidence.excerpt: The central bank said the late-February rate hike and capital controls helped support the stable functioning of the financial system.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary official statement directly linking policy tools to observed stabilization.
evidence.ruler_attribution: mostly indirect to Putin because the bank carried out the stabilization, though it operated inside his regime's wartime policy framework.
contrary_evidence: Stabilization was defensive and partial, not proof of broad economic success.

evidence.claim: The Bank of Russia stated that price stability close to 4 percent is its main goal and that forecast-based decisions and transparency are core monetary-policy principles.
evidence.title: Bank of Russia monetary policy 2022-2024
evidence.excerpt: The Bank of Russia stated that price stability close to 4 percent is its main goal and that forecast-based decisions and transparency are core monetary-policy principles.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary policy framework document from the central bank.
evidence.ruler_attribution: indirect to Putin; this documents the institutional framework rather than a personal directive.
contrary_evidence: Institutional principles do not prove that Putin himself governed competently.

evidence.claim: The IMF said Russia's domestic economy had been doing fairly well because emergency financial and monetary measures helped stabilize the financial sector, even though the projected medium-term outlook remained weak.
evidence.title: Russia's domestic economy had been doing fairly well because emergency financial and monetary measures helped stabilize the financial sector
evidence.excerpt: The IMF said Russia's domestic economy had been doing fairly well because emergency financial and monetary measures helped stabilize the financial sector, even though the projected medium-term outlook remained weak.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary IMF transcript from a formal public briefing, directly summarizing the macro response and its limits.
evidence.ruler_attribution: mixed: the stabilization reflected both Putin's wartime policy environment and the central bank's emergency measures.
contrary_evidence: The IMF also emphasized that the medium-term outlook remained weak.

evidence.claim: The IMF said sanctions on the Russian Central Bank would severely restrict access to reserves and disrupt cross-border transactions, and it urged fiscal policy to support the most vulnerable.
evidence.title: IMF staff statement on the economic impact of war in Ukraine
evidence.excerpt: The IMF said sanctions on the Russian Central Bank would severely restrict access to reserves and disrupt cross-border transactions, and it urged fiscal policy to support the most vulnerable.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary IMF statement contemporaneous with the sanctions shock.
evidence.ruler_attribution: indirect to Putin; this is an external constraint created by his war policy and the international response.
contrary_evidence: The statement is about constraints and advice, not proof of Putin's competence or incompetence by itself.

evidence.claim: The OECD said sanctions cut Russia off from foreign capital and reserves, the ruble depreciated sharply, the policy rate rose to 20 percent, and the downturn could be larger than earlier expected.
evidence.title: OECD Economic Outlook, Volume 2022 Issue 2
evidence.excerpt: The OECD said sanctions cut Russia off from foreign capital and reserves, the ruble depreciated sharply, the policy rate rose to 20 percent, and the downturn could be larger than earlier expected.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Major international institution synthesis using cross-country macro data and policy analysis.
evidence.ruler_attribution: mixed: Putin's war decision created the shock, but the OECD's focus is on the combined effects of sanctions and policy response.
contrary_evidence: The OECD text shows that external sanctions were a major driver, not only Putin's internal management.

evidence.claim: Putin said Russia would post a budget surplus in 2022 and forecast GDP would fall around 2 percent, presenting the economic trajectory as milder than many outside forecasts.
evidence.title: Russia economy: Putin forum
evidence.excerpt: Putin said Russia would post a budget surplus in 2022 and forecast GDP would fall around 2 percent, presenting the economic trajectory as milder than many outside forecasts.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting captures a public macro forecast and self-assessment from Putin.
evidence.ruler_attribution: direct public claim by Putin, though outcome depended on sanctions, central-bank actions, and war spending.
contrary_evidence: Later year-end data showed a more mixed and weaker household picture than the rhetoric suggested.

evidence.claim: Putin signed the law approving the 2022 federal budget execution report; it records 27.824 trillion rubles in revenue, 31.119 trillion rubles in spending, and a 3.295 trillion ruble deficit.
evidence.title: Федеральный закон от 24 июля 2023 года № 329-ФЗ Об исполнении федерального бюджета за 2022 год
evidence.excerpt: Putin signed the law approving the 2022 federal budget execution report; it records 27.824 trillion rubles in revenue, 31.119 trillion rubles in spending, and a 3.295 trillion ruble deficit.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary publication of the enacted federal law with exact budget totals and signature date.
evidence.ruler_attribution: direct presidential approval of the budget execution law, though execution was carried by the wider fiscal apparatus
contrary_evidence: The result was a deficit, not the budget balance implied by the original 2022 plan.

evidence.claim: The government indexed pensions, the subsistence minimum, and the minimum wage by 10 percent from 1 June 2022, explicitly saying the decision was taken on Putin's order.
evidence.title: Правительство проиндексировало пенсии, прожиточный минимум и минимальный размер оплаты труда на 10%
evidence.excerpt: The government indexed pensions, the subsistence minimum, and the minimum wage by 10 percent from 1 June 2022, explicitly saying the decision was taken on Putin's order.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official government decree with a clear policy change and attribution, though the page itself timed out on direct open.
evidence.ruler_attribution: directly attributable to Putin's order and the government's implementation
contrary_evidence: This is compensatory crisis policy, not proof of a durable welfare improvement on its own.

evidence.claim: The ministry said 588,000 budget-funded university places were allocated in 2022, the largest number in 10-15 years, plus 30,000 extra master's places for priority programs because of the difficult geopolitical situation.
evidence.title: Валерий Фальков: в этом году было выделено самое большое количество бюджетных мест за последние 10-15 лет
evidence.publisher: Министерство науки и высшего образования Российской Федерации
evidence.excerpt: The ministry said 588,000 budget-funded university places were allocated in 2022, the largest number in 10-15 years, plus 30,000 extra master's places for priority programs because of the difficult geopolitical situation.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official ministry press release with a concrete allocation figure, but the page returned a 502 on direct open and is retained from the search snippet.
evidence.ruler_attribution: indirect but substantial; this reflects Putin-era education policy priorities implemented through the ministry
contrary_evidence: The release proves input and allocation, not that quality or labor-market outcomes improved equally.

evidence.claim: Putin ordered the government to create a commission on unmanned aircraft systems chaired by First Deputy Prime Minister Andrei Belousov and to draft a 2030 and 2035 strategy, procurement plan, certification framework, training system, and related interagency measures.
evidence.title: Instructions on developing unmanned aircraft systems
evidence.excerpt: Putin ordered the government to create a commission on unmanned aircraft systems chaired by First Deputy Prime Minister Andrei Belousov and to draft a 2030 and 2035 strategy, procurement plan, certification framework, training system, and related interagency measures.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary Kremlin instructions with named chair, deadlines, and implementation tasks, directly visible in the search result snippet.
evidence.ruler_attribution: directly attributable to Putin's command authority over the cabinet and security ministries
contrary_evidence: This is strong evidence of mobilization and planning, but not yet proof of durable delivery by year-end.
